{{Top}}
The '''HoloNet relays''', also known as '''HoloNet relay stations''',<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> were [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] based computer sorters and decoders used in the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] network to send messages from [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|transceiver]] to transceiver.

The [[Mabugat kan]] was a creature used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] designed to consume HoloNet relays by tracing the HoloNet signals to their source and generating a singularity.
